delta:
# Story 01 — Agent load report page (Story: CRM-129)

## Prerequisites

- **
REPORTS-3-API (CRM-128)** ships the backend endpoint this page reads (see `api/src/features/reports/`). This story

is web-only and **cannot merge before CRM-128**.
- Familiarity with the admin-only page pattern used by `web/src/pages/audit/` — the same

shape (page component + hook + css) and the same route protection (`isAdmin === true`) are reused here.

---

## Story

Goal

Give an admin a single-screen report of load per agent:

1. Every agent is listed, including idle ones (load

`0`), sorted by load descending. Idle agents remain visible — they must survive the sort, and the list is **never** truncated to a top-N.
2. **Unassigned work** is pres

ented as its own figure (a separate summary next to the list), not as an agent row named "nobody" / "unassigned".
3. A desk with a single agent still renders as a report

, not an error.
4. In both `en` and `ar`, agent **names render as stored** (untranslated); only the surrounding labels come from the res

ource files.

Out of scope: API work (CRM-128), reassigning agents from this screen, charts/avatars/capacity targets, the period pic

ker (CRM-131).

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogPage.tsx` — the reference page.
Note the admin gate at lines around 37–49 (`const { isAdmin } = useMe()`, `enabled: isAdmin === true`, and the

"not admin" branch). Copy the shape.
2. `web/src/pages/audit/useAuditLog.ts` — reference hook that fires only when `en

abled` is true (line 25 signature). Match this contract: **do not fetch before the subject's role is known** (L-63).
3. `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLog
Page.test.tsx` and `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogPage.css` — mirror the test cases (admin-only, loading, empty, r

endered rows) and stylistic conventions.
4. `web/src/app/routes.tsx` — audit route treatment sits around line 161 with admin-only gating. Add the new route the same way.

5. `web/src/shared/session/use-me.ts` — provides `isAdmin`. Use it here to gate the fetch and render.
6. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — request

wrapper used by the audit hook; reuse it for the reports call.
7. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` — HTTP client used across pages.
8. `web/src/shared/i18n
/en.ts`, `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — add all new labels here (parity must hold). Grep for the audit page keys as

a naming template.
9. `web/src/shared/i18n/format.ts` — `formatNumber` is defined around line 12; use it via `useFormatters().formatNumber` for every count so dig

its follow the active locale.
10. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` and `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — both will run against this feature;

every user-facing string must live in `en.ts`/`ar.ts` and both locales must have identical keys.
11. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` —

`Card`, `Stack`, `Heading`, `Text`, `EmptyState`, `ErrorState`, `Skeleton` primitives to reuse.
12. `api/src/features/reports/reports.routes.js`
, `reports.read.js`, `reports.repository.js` — read the endpoint that CRM-128 lands (e.g. `GET /reports/agent-load`) to confirm the exact URL,

response shape (agents array + unassigned figure), and field names before wiring the hook.
13. Grep for `usePromiseShare` and `useQueueBy
Status` in `web/src/pages/reports/` for prior reports-page hooks that already call the reports API — match their client-call

conventions.

---

## Product rules (from story)

- **Idle agents survive the sort.** Ordering is load descending; zeros sit at the bottom but are always rendered. No "top N

" trimming.
- **Unassigned is a figure, not a row.** Render it as a distinct card/heading beside the list, never inside the

agent list, and never with a placeholder name.
- **Single-agent desks** render the report layout with one row; emp

ty-agent-list is a separate empty state.
- **Names are data.** Labels around a name come from `en.ts`/`ar.ts`; the name itself is rendered verbatim from the API.
- **Num

bers go through `formatNumber`.** No raw `String(n)` or `{count}` interpolation without the formatter.

---

##

Implementation tasks

### 1 — Create the hook

Create file: `web/src/pages/reports/useAgentLoad.ts`

- Signature: `export function useAgentLoad({ enab

led = true }: { enabled?: boolean } = {})`.
- Internally call the shared request hook (mirror `useAuditLog.ts`), hitting the endpoint C

RM-128 provides (verify the path in `api/src/features/reports/reports.routes.js` — expected `GET /reports/agent-load`).
- When `enabled ===

false`, the hook must not fire the request (guard on the `enabled` flag exactly like `useAuditLog`).
- Return `
{ loading, error, data }` where `data` is `{ agents: Array<{ id: string; name: string; load: number }>; unassigned: number } | null`. Match the actual API field names once CRM-128 l

ands; adjust types accordingly.
- Sort `data.agents` by `load` descending in the hook (stable secondary sort by `name`

to keep ties deterministic). **Do not slice.**

### 2 — Create the page component

Create file: `web/src/pages/reports/AgentLoadPage.tsx`

- Follow `

AuditLogPage.tsx` structure:
  - `const { isAdmin } = useMe();`
  - `const report = useAgentLoad({ enabled: isAdmin === true });`
  - While `isAdmin === undefined`,

render a `Skeleton` (or the same "loading" primitive the audit page uses) — **do not fetch yet**.
  - When `isAdmin === false`, render the same not-auth

orised branch as the audit page.
  - When `report.loading`, render `Skeleton`.
  - When `report.error`, render `ErrorState` with a label key from `en.ts

`.
  - On success:
    - A `Heading` with key e.g. `reports.agentLoad.title`.
    - A **separate `Card`** for the unassigned figure, labelled
by `reports.agentLoad.unassignedLabel`, value via `formatNumber(report.data.unassigned)`. Visually distinct from the agent list (its own card/region, not a row).
- A list (semantic `<ul>` or a `Stack`) of agents, one row per agent, showing `{name}` verbatim and `form

atNumber(agent.load)`. Rows for `load === 0` render identically to non-zero rows.
    - If `report.data.agents.length ===
0`, render `EmptyState` with a labelled key `reports.agentLoad.noAgents` (this is the true empty; a single-agent desk falls through to the list rendering

).
- **No hard-coded strings.** Every visible piece of text comes from `useTranslation`/i18n resources

.
- **Names are not translated.** Render `agent.name` directly — do not wrap in `t(...)`.

### 3 — Page styles

Create file: `web/src/pages/reports/AgentLoad

Page.css`

- Mirror `AuditLogPage.css` conventions (single class prefix, e.g. `.agent-load`).
- Keep the unassigned figure visually separated from the list (its own card/pan

el with distinct spacing).
- Do not introduce mirrored/logical directional styles that would fail `no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`.

### 4 — Route

wiring

File: `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

- Add a route `/reports/agent-load` (or the naming the sibling reports pages already use — ver

ify via `grep 'reports/queue-by-status'` and `grep 'reports/promise-share'`).
- Apply the **same admin-only tre
atment** as the `/audit` route at ~line 161. The gate is the `isAdmin === true` check the page itself performs; the route entry should be structurally identical to the audit ent

ry.
- Lazy-load the page consistently with sibling admin routes.

### 5 — Navigation entry

File: `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.t

sx`

- Add a navigation link to the new page, visible only to admins, alongside the existing Audit / Reports entries. Use a resource key for the label;

no hard-coded string.

### 6 — i18n resources

File: `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

- Add matching keys to **both** files. Suggested t

ree:
  - `reports.agentLoad.title`
  - `reports.agentLoad.navLabel`
  - `reports.agentLoad.unassignedLabel`
  - `reports.agentLoad.agentColumnLabel`
  - `reports.agentL

oad.loadColumnLabel`
  - `reports.agentLoad.noAgents`
  - `reports.agentLoad.loadingLabel`
  - `reports.agentLoad.errorLabel`
- Keys must be present in **both** loc

ales (parity). Arabic translations are the human strings; agent names are never listed here.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **`
isAdmin === undefined` during first render.** The hook is gated by `enabled: isAdmin === true`, so the request must not fire until `/me` settles.

Verified by mirroring `AuditLogPage.tsx:41`.
- **`isAdmin === false`.** Render the same not-authorised branch as `AuditLogPage.tsx:49`; do

not fetch.
- **Empty agent list.** Show `EmptyState` with an i18n label; still render the unassigned figure.
- **Single agent.** Renders as a

one-row list — no error, no special case.
- **All agents idle (all loads = 0).** All rows render with `formatNumber(0)`

; unassigned figure still renders separately.
- **Sort stability.** Ties are broken by name so that two agents with the same load do not swap on re-render.
- **List size

.** Never truncate. No `.slice(0, N)` anywhere in the hook or page.
- **Locale digits.** Every num

eric value passes through `useFormatters().formatNumber`; Arabic must render Arabic-Indic digits (`format.ts:~12`).
- **Non-ASCII names.** `ag

ent.name` rendered verbatim; no translation wrapper. `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` accepts data values that come from state, not literals.
- **API error /

network failure.** Show `ErrorState` with an i18n label — do not blank the page.
- **Unassigned field missing / null.** Treat as `0` for display; still render

the figure card.

---

## Test Plan

Create file: `web/src/pages/reports/AgentLoadPage.test.tsx` — mirror the structure of `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogPage

.test.tsx`.

1. **Does not fetch until `/me` resolves** — stub `useMe` to return `{ isAdmin: undefined }`, assert no request is issued (L-63 gu

ard).
2. **Non-admin gets the not-authorised branch** — `isAdmin: false`, assert the audit-style "not authorised" text and no fetch.
3.
**Admin sees the report** — `isAdmin: true`, stub the endpoint with 3 agents (loads 5, 0, 2) and unassig

ned 4. Assert:
   - agents appear in order `5, 2, 0` (idle survives),
   - the row with load `0` is visible,
   - unassigned figure `

4` appears **outside** the agents list container.
4. **Single-agent desk renders a report** — one agent, no error thrown, list renders one row.
5. **Emp
ty agent list** — zero agents, unassigned `0`; the empty-state key from `en.ts` is shown, no cr

ash.
6. **Names are untranslated** — an agent named `"محمد"` renders verbatim regardless of active language.
7. **Numbers use `form

atNumber`** — switch locale to `ar`, assert digits render in the locale format (Arabic-Indic).
8. **No hard-coded strings** — covered glob

ally by `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`; ensure the new page passes.
9. **i18n parity** — covered globally by `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts`; every

key added to `en.ts` must exist in `ar.ts`.
10. **Route gating** — if `web/src/app/routing.test.tsx` covers admin route access, add a case that a

non-admin navigating to `/reports/agent-load` is treated the same as `/audit`.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd web && npm test` — the whole v

itest suite must be green, including `AgentLoadPage.test.tsx`, `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`, `parity.test.ts`, and `no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`.
2. **Frontend builds:** `cd web && npm
run build` — this is the only step that runs `tsc -b`; a change vitest has seen is

not verified without it.
3. **Backend still builds:** `cd api && npm test` — sanity check that the new frontend call matches the CRM-128

contract; no API changes in this story.
4. **Regression:** manually visit `/audit` and `/reports/agent-load` as admin and as non-admin; confirm ident

ical gating behaviour.
5. **AI-attribution guard:** `git grep -nE 'AI|Copilot|Claude|ChatGPT|
Anthropic|OpenAI' -- ':!package-lock.json' ':!web/package-lock.json'

` — must be empty (per standing rule, no commit may mention AI assistance).

---

## Done

Criteria

- [ ] Idle agents render with `0` in the same list as busy agents; sort-by-load-desc keeps them visible.
- [ ] Unassigned work renders as a

distinct figure, not as an agent row.
- [ ] A one-agent desk renders the report without error.
- [ ] Agent names render verbatim in both `en` and `ar`; surrounding labels come from resource files.
- [

] All counts pass through `useFormatters().formatNumber`.
- [ ] The page follows the `web/src/pages/audit/` shape (page + hook + css) and the `/audit` adm

in-route treatment.
- [ ] The hook does not fetch until `isAdmin === true` (L-63).
- [ ] `parity.test.ts` and `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts

` pass; `npm run build` and `npm test` are green in `web/`.
- [ ] No commit, doc, or ignore-file entry mentions AI assistance.

**STOP H
ERE. Report to the user and wait for confirmation before proceeding to the next story.**
